1: // anymodel Cloudflare Worker handler
2: // Shared logic for both CF Workers and local testing
3: // Uses fetch() API — no Node.js http/https modules
4: 
5: export const DEFAULT_FREE_MODEL = 'nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free';
6: 
7: export function checkAuth(headers, token) {
8:   if (!token) return true;
9:   const auth = headers.authorization || headers['x-api-key'] || '';
10:   // Exact token match (x-api-key or Bearer prefix)
11:   if (auth === `Bearer ${token}` || auth === token) return true;
12:   return false;
13: }
14: 
15: export function isFreeTierModel(modelId, freeOnly) {
16:   if (!freeOnly) return true;
17:   if (!modelId) return false;
18:   return modelId === 'openrouter/free' || modelId.endsWith(':free');
19: }
20: 
21: // Rate limiter factory — returns a stateful checker
22: checkRateLimit.create = function(rpm) {
23:   const windows = {};
24:   return {
25:     check(ip) {
26:       const minute = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000);
27:       const key = `${ip}:${minute}`;
28:       // Clean old entries
29:       for (const k of Object.keys(windows)) {
30:         if (!k.endsWith(`:${minute}`)) delete windows[k];
31:       }
32:       windows[key] = (windows[key] || 0) + 1;
33:       return windows[key] <= rpm;
34:     }
35:   };
36: };
37: 
38: export function checkRateLimit(ip, rpm, state) {
39:   const minute = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000);
40:   const key = `${ip}:${minute}`;
41:   for (const k of Object.keys(state)) {
42:     if (!k.endsWith(`:${minute}`)) delete state[k];
43:   }
44:   state[key] = (state[key] || 0) + 1;
45:   return state[key] <= rpm;
46: }
47: 
48: export function buildOpenRouterRequest(path, apiKey, model) {
49:   return {
50:     url: `https://openrouter.ai/api${path}`,
51:     headers: {
52:       'content-type': 'application/json',
53:       'authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
54:       'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
55:       'http-referer': 'https://anymodel.dev',
56:       'x-title': 'anymodel',
57:     },
58:   };
59: }
60: 
61: // Strip Anthropic-specific fields (same logic as proxy.mjs but standalone for Workers)
62: export function sanitizeBody(body) {
63:   delete body.betas;
64:   delete body.metadata;
65:   delete body.speed;
66:   delete body.output_config;
67:   delete body.context_management;
68:   // Preserve body.thinking — reasoning models (DeepSeek R1) need it for chain-of-thought
69: 
70:   if (Array.isArray(body.system)) {
71:     body.system = body.system.map(block => {
72:       if (block && typeof block === 'object' && block.cache_control) {
73:         const { cache_control, ...rest } = block;
74:         return rest;
75:       }
76:       return block;
77:     });
78:   }
79: 
80:   if (Array.isArray(body.messages)) {
81:     for (const msg of body.messages) {
82:       if (Array.isArray(msg.content)) {
83:         msg.content = msg.content.map(block => {
84:           if (block && typeof block === 'object' && block.cache_control) {
85:             const { cache_control, ...rest } = block;
86:             return rest;
87:           }
88:           return block;
89:         });
90:       }
91:     }
92:   }
93: 
94:   if (Array.isArray(body.tools)) {
95:     body.tools = body.tools.map(tool => {
96:       const { cache_control, defer_loading, eager_input_streaming, strict, ...rest } = tool;
97:       return rest;
98:     });
99:   }
100: 
101:   if (typeof body.tool_choice === 'string') {
102:     body.tool_choice = { type: body.tool_choice };
103:   }
104: 
105:   return body;
106: }
107: 
108: const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
109: 
110: function calcDelay(attempt) {
111:   return Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1), 8000);
112: }

114: // Main request handler — works with fetch() API (CF Workers + Node 18+)
115: export async function handleRequest(request, env) {
116:   const url = new URL(request.url);
117:   const token = env.ANYMODEL_TOKEN || '';
118:   const apiKey = env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY || '';
119:   const freeOnly = env.FREE_ONLY === 'true'; // default false — set FREE_ONLY=true to restrict to free models
120:   const rpm = parseInt(env.RPM || '60', 10);
121:   const model = env.MODEL || '';
122: 
123:   // Health endpoint
124:   if (request.method === 'GET' && url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') === '/health') {
125:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
126:       status: 'ok',
127:       provider: 'openrouter',
128:       model: model || null,
129:       freeOnly,
130:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
131:     }), { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
132:   }
133: 
134:   // Passthrough non-message requests to api.anthropic.com (auth, bootstrap, feature flags)
135:   if (!url.pathname.startsWith('/v1/messages')) {
136:     const anthropicUrl = `https://api.anthropic.com${url.pathname}${url.search}`;
137:     const passthroughHeaders = new Headers(request.headers);
138:     passthroughHeaders.set('host', 'api.anthropic.com');
139:     passthroughHeaders.delete('cf-connecting-ip');
140:     passthroughHeaders.delete('cf-ray');
141:     passthroughHeaders.delete('cf-ipcountry');
142:     try {
143:       const upstream = await fetch(anthropicUrl, {
144:         method: request.method,
145:         headers: passthroughHeaders,
146:         body: request.method !== 'GET' && request.method !== 'HEAD' ? request.body : undefined,
147:       });
148:       return new Response(upstream.body, {
149:         status: upstream.status,
150:         headers: upstream.headers,
151:       });
152:     } catch (e) {
153:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
154:         error: { type: 'proxy_error', message: `Passthrough to Anthropic failed: ${e.message}` }
155:       }), { status: 502, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
156:     }
157:   }
158: 
159:   // BYOK: Use the user's key from the request header, fall back to server key
160:   const headers = Object.fromEntries(request.headers.entries());
161:   const userKey = headers['x-api-key'] || headers['authorization']?.replace('Bearer ', '') || '';
162:   const effectiveKey = (userKey && userKey.startsWith('sk-or-')) ? userKey : apiKey;
163: 
164:   if (!effectiveKey) {
165:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
166:       error: { type: 'auth_error', message: 'OpenRouter API key required. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to your OpenRouter key (starts with sk-or-).' }
167:     }), { status: 401, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
168:   }
169: 
170:   // Rate limit (using global state for Workers)
171:   const clientIp = headers['cf-connecting-ip'] || headers['x-forwarded-for']?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'unknown';
172:   if (!handleRequest._rateState) handleRequest._rateState = {};
173:   if (!checkRateLimit(clientIp, rpm, handleRequest._rateState)) {
174:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
175:       error: { type: 'rate_limit', message: `Rate limit: ${rpm} requests/minute exceeded` }
176:     }), { status: 429, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
177:   }
178: 
179:   // Parse body
180:   let body;
181:   try {
182:     body = await request.json();
183:   } catch {
184:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
185:       error: { type: 'invalid_request', message: 'Invalid JSON' }
186:     }), { status: 400, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
187:   }
188: 
189:   // Model override
190:   if (model) body.model = model;
191: 
192:   // Free-only: auto-replace paid models with best free model
193:   const defaultFreeModel = env.DEFAULT_FREE_MODEL || DEFAULT_FREE_MODEL;
194:   if (freeOnly && !isFreeTierModel(body.model, true)) {
195:     const originalModel = body.model;
196:     body.model = defaultFreeModel;
197:     // Add a header so client knows model was swapped
198:     console.log(`[FREE-ONLY] Swapped ${originalModel} → ${body.model}`);
199:   }
200: 
201:   // Sanitize
202:   sanitizeBody(body);
203:   const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
204: 
205:   // Forward to OpenRouter with retries (using user's key or server fallback)
206:   const orReq = buildOpenRouterRequest(url.pathname, effectiveKey);
207: 
208:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_RETRIES; attempt++) {
209:     try {
210:       const response = await fetch(orReq.url, {
211:         method: 'POST',
212:         headers: { ...orReq.headers, 'content-length': new TextEncoder().encode(payload).length.toString() },
213:         body: payload,
214:       });
215: 
216:       if (response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500) {
217:         if (attempt === MAX_RETRIES) {
218:           return new Response(await response.text(), {
219:             status: response.status,
220:             headers: { 'content-type': response.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json' },
221:           });
222:         }
223:         await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, calcDelay(attempt)));
224:         continue;
225:       }
226: 
227:       // Stream response back
228:       return new Response(response.body, {
229:         status: response.status,
230:         headers: {
231:           'content-type': response.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json',
232:           'access-control-allow-origin': '*',
233:         },
234:       });
235: 
236:     } catch (e) {
237:       if (attempt === MAX_RETRIES) {
238:         return new Response(JSON.stringify({
239:           error: { type: 'proxy_error', message: e.message }
240:         }), { status: 502, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
241:       }
242:       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, calcDelay(attempt)));
243:     }
244:   }
245: }

- Both credential headers are checked independently, allowing gateway authentication and BYOK in separate headers.
